m: **Record** it and **recollect** it later: **memory**, to remember.
ex: 我对那天没有什么记忆了。
I have hardly any memory of that day.
老人的记忆力越来越差。
The old man's memory is getting worse and worse.
use: 记忆力 is the ability to remember; 回忆 is looking back on the past.

ex: 波兰在欧洲中部。
Poland is in central Europe.
我的同事是波兰人。
My colleague is Polish.
use: Country name chosen for its sound.

m: The **species** of a **fish**, or **fish** grown from **seed**: **fish species**; **fingerlings**.
ex: 这个湖里有几十种鱼种。
There are dozens of fish species in this lake.
农民在鱼塘里放了很多鱼种。
The farmers stocked the pond with lots of fingerlings.
use: Means fish species, or young fish for stocking ponds.

ex: 这种可能性很小。
This possibility is very slim.
明天下雨的可能性很大。
There's a good chance of rain tomorrow.
use: Goes with 大 and 小, not 高 and 低 in speech.

ex: 安陆是湖北的一个城市。
Anlu is a city in Hubei.
李白年轻时在安陆住过。
Li Bai lived in Anlu when he was young.
use: Place name.

ex: 这本书是中国历史的概览。
This book is an overview of Chinese history.
请先看一下网站的概览。
Please read the site overview first.
use: Written; used as a heading or title.

ex: 山上到处是白雪。
There is white snow all over the mountain.
白雪公主是一个童话故事。
Snow White is a fairy tale.
use: Descriptive and literary; everyday word is 雪.

m: **Speak** about it and get to the bottom **after all**: be **particular about**, fussy.
ex: 他吃饭很讲究。
He's very particular about food.
中国人过年有很多讲究。
Chinese New Year comes with lots of customs to observe.
use: 讲究 + noun: 讲究卫生, care about hygiene; also a noun, a custom.

ex: 这个地区的农产品很丰富。
This area has plenty of farm produce.
我们直接从农民那里买农产品。
We buy farm produce straight from the farmers.
use: Measure word 种.

ex: 我们队的防守很好。
Our team's defence is very good.
他负责防守对方的前锋。
He's in charge of marking the other team's striker.
use: Sports and military; opposite 进攻, attack.

ex: 这座房子是民国时期建的。
This house was built in the Republican era.
我喜欢看民国的老照片。
I like looking at old photos from the Republic of China era.
use: Usually 民国时期, the Republican period.

ex: 博物馆里展出了很多古代兵器。
The museum shows many ancient weapons.
刀和剑都是兵器。
Knives and swords are both weapons.
use: Often for old weapons; modern ones are 武器.

ex: 我爸爸是一名工程师。
My dad is an engineer.
她想当软件工程师。
She wants to be a software engineer.
use: Measure word 名 or 位.

ex: 他们决定提起诉讼。
They decided to file a lawsuit.
这场诉讼持续了两年。
The lawsuit dragged on for two years.
use: Formal legal word; 打官司 is the spoken way.

ex: 请确认你的订单。
Please confirm your order.
我打电话确认了一下时间。
I phoned to confirm the time.
use: Confirm details or identity; 证实 is confirm that news is true.

ex: 这家公司是他父亲创立的。
This company was founded by his father.
她在二十岁时创立了自己的品牌。
She founded her own brand at twenty.
use: For companies, schools, theories; 成立 is set up.

ex: 我跟他没有什么往来。
I don't have much contact with him.
两国的贸易往来越来越多。
Trade between the two countries keeps growing.
use: Contact between people, companies or countries.

ex: 我非常感激你的帮助。
I'm very grateful for your help.
他感激地看着医生。
He looked at the doctor gratefully.
use: Stronger than 感谢; 感激不尽, endlessly grateful.

m: **Not having** any way out: **helpless**, no alternative.
ex: 他无奈地笑了笑。
He gave a helpless smile.
下雨了，我们无奈只好回家。
It started raining, so we had no choice but to go home.
use: Often 很无奈 or 出于无奈; spoken 没办法.

ex: 奶奶做了一盘糯米团子。
Grandma made a plate of sticky rice balls.
这种团子里面有豆沙。
These rice balls have red bean paste inside.
use: A round glutinous rice snack; also used for Japanese dango.

ex: 很多国家向灾区提供了援助。
Many countries gave aid to the disaster area.
我们应该援助有困难的人。
We should help people in difficulty.
use: Formal; often for aid between countries.

ex: 他很有本事。
He's very capable.
有本事你自己去做！
If you're so clever, do it yourself!
use: 有本事 can be a challenge: if you think you can.

m: The **mouth** of the **river**: a **river mouth**; also a place name.
ex: 这座城市在河口附近。
This city is near the river mouth.
我们去河口看日落。
We went to the estuary to watch the sunset.
use: Also a district name; 入海口 is where a river meets the sea.

m: **Down** under your **foot**: **underfoot**, at the foot of.
ex: 下雨路滑，小心脚下！
The road is slippery in the rain, watch your step!
他家就在山脚下。
His home is right at the foot of the hill.
use: 小心脚下 is a common warning sign.

ex: 店里的衣服一律八折。
Everything in the shop is twenty percent off.
外人一律不准进入。
Outsiders are not allowed in, without exception.
use: Common on notices; before the verb.

ex: 士兵们保卫着国家。
The soldiers defend the country.
我们要保卫自己的家园。
We must defend our homeland.
use: Strong and formal; 保卫处 is a security office.

ex: 他一直在暗中帮助我。
He's been helping me in secret all along.
警察暗中跟着那辆车。
The police secretly followed that car.
use: Before the verb; 偷偷 is the spoken word.

ex: 这首歌征服了所有观众。
This song won over the whole audience.
他们终于征服了这座高山。
They finally conquered this high mountain.
use: Also figurative: win over hearts.

ex: 长江最后注入东海。
The Yangtze finally flows into the East China Sea.
新同事给团队注入了活力。
The new colleagues brought fresh energy to the team.
use: Literal for rivers and liquids, figurative for energy and money.

ex: 这本书深受学生喜爱。
This book is much loved by students.
他深受父亲的影响。
He was deeply influenced by his father.
use: Goes with 欢迎, 喜爱, 影响.

m: **Gather** it all and **report**: **report** to a superior.
ex: 我要向经理汇报工作。
I need to report to the manager on my work.
明天上午有一个工作汇报。
There's a work report tomorrow morning.
use: 向 + boss + 汇报; reporting upward.

ex: 写作需要技巧。
Writing takes technique.
她教了我很多学习技巧。
She taught me many study tips.
use: Often 说话技巧, 学习技巧.

m: The **character** of an **article** or person: **quality**, character.
ex: 他是一个品质很好的人。
He's a person of good character.
这家店的东西品质不错。
The things in this shop are good quality.
use: For people's moral character and product quality.

ex: 她从小就喜欢写诗歌。
She has loved writing poetry since she was little.
这本书收了很多现代诗歌。
This book collects many modern poems.
use: Usually poetry in general; one poem is 一首诗.

m: The **round** group sitting on the **chairman**'s **mat**: a **presidium**.
ex: 大会选出了主席团。
The congress elected a presidium.
主席团成员坐在台上。
The presidium members sit on the stage.
use: Formal, for congresses and conferences.

ex: 我想出去走走，不料下起了大雨。
I wanted to go for a walk, but unexpectedly it started pouring.
本来以为他会同意，不料他拒绝了。
I'd thought he would agree, but to my surprise he refused.
use: Starts the second clause; like 没想到 but written.

ex: 请不要干扰别人学习。
Please don't disturb others while they study.
手机信号受到了干扰。
The phone signal was interfered with.
use: 干 here is gān, interfere; also used for radio interference.

m: The **spleen**'s **air**, an old idea of mood: **temper**, temperament.
ex: 他的脾气很好。
He's very good-tempered.
别发脾气了。
Stop losing your temper.
use: 发脾气 means lose one's temper.

ex: 我们明天去爬长城。
We're going to climb the Great Wall tomorrow.
长城有几千年的历史。
The Great Wall has thousands of years of history.
use: Here 长 is cháng, long.

ex: 北京在北纬四十度左右。
Beijing is at about forty degrees north latitude.
这个岛位于北纬二十度。
This island lies at twenty degrees north.
use: 南纬 is south latitude; 经度 is longitude.

ex: 草原非常广阔。
The grassland is vast.
年轻人的前途很广阔。
Young people have broad prospects.
use: For land and sky, and for prospects.

m: **Scale** a height and get **up**: **climb onto**, board.
ex: 我们终于登上了山顶。
We finally reached the top of the mountain.
旅客们登上了飞机。
The passengers boarded the plane.
use: Object is a high place or vehicle.

ex: 他听了大为感动。
He was greatly moved when he heard it.
情况大为改善。
The situation has greatly improved.
use: Written; before two-syllable verbs or adjectives.

m: A **liquid** in which something has **dissolved**: a **solution**.
ex: 把盐放进水里就成了盐溶液。
Put salt in water and you get a salt solution.
这种溶液不能喝。
This solution must not be drunk.
use: Chemistry term.

ex: 我只是短期在这里工作。
I'm only working here short-term.
这个问题短期内解决不了。
This problem can't be solved in the short term.
use: Opposite 长期; 短期内, in the short term.

ex: 早上八点是上班高峰。
Eight in the morning is the rush hour.
这是他事业的高峰。
This is the peak of his career.
use: Very common in 高峰期 and 早高峰, rush hour.

ex: 丐帮是武侠小说里的一个帮派。
The Beggars' Sect is a gang in martial arts novels.
他在小说里是丐帮的帮主。
In the novel he is the head of the Beggars' Sect.
use: Mostly from martial arts fiction.

ex: 请旅客们排队上车。
Passengers, please queue to board.
火车站里有很多旅客。
There are lots of travellers in the station.
use: Used in stations and airports; 游客 is tourist.

ex: 木头在火里燃烧。
The wood is burning in the fire.
他的心里燃烧着希望。
Hope burns in his heart.
use: More formal than 烧; also figurative.

ex: 鄂州市在长江边上。
Ezhou City is on the Yangtze.
她在鄂州市工作。
She works in Ezhou City.
use: 市 marks a city.

ex: 仙桃市在湖北省中部。
Xiantao City is in central Hubei.
她是仙桃市人。
She's from Xiantao.
use: 市 marks a city; the name means immortal's peach.

ex: 我们协商一下再决定吧。
Let's talk it over before deciding.
双方经过协商达成了一致。
After consultation, both sides reached agreement.
use: Often 跟…协商 or 经过协商.

ex: 荆门市离武汉不远。
Jingmen City isn't far from Wuhan.
我们在荆门市停了一天。
We stopped for a day in Jingmen.
use: 市 marks a city.

m: **Divided** off and **supported** on the side: a **branch**.
ex: 这家公司在上海有一个分支机构。
This company has a branch office in Shanghai.
这条河有很多分支。
This river has many branches.
use: Branches of companies, rivers, subjects; 分店 is a shop branch.

ex: 我每天下午去图书馆看书。
I go to the library to read every afternoon.
学校的图书馆周末也开门。
The school library is open at weekends too.
use: Measure word 个 or 座.

m: **Lean on** and **borrow** strength: **rely on**, by means of.
ex: 他凭借自己的努力考上了大学。
He got into university through his own hard work.
这部电影凭借好故事赢得了观众。
The film won over audiences on the strength of its story.
use: Written; spoken 靠 or 凭.

ex: 我爷爷以前是木工。
My grandfather used to be a carpenter.
他在学校学过木工。
He learned woodwork at school.
use: Both the craft and the worker; also 木匠.

m: A **martial** **device** using the atom's **pit**, its nucleus: a **nuclear weapon**.
ex: 世界上有几个国家有核武器。
A few countries in the world have nuclear weapons.
人们希望消除核武器。
People hope to get rid of nuclear weapons.
use: 核 means nucleus, core.

ex: 这两条线互相垂直。
These two lines are perpendicular.
请把杆子垂直放好。
Please stand the pole up vertically.
use: Geometry and building; 水平 is horizontal.

ex: 银行就在学校对面。
The bank is right opposite the school.
对面那个人是谁？
Who is that person across from us?
use: Pattern: A 在 B 对面; 对面的, the one across.

ex: 山上的冰川正在融化。
The glaciers on the mountain are melting.
我们去看了一条很大的冰川。
We went to see a huge glacier.
use: Measure word 条 or 座.

ex: 我在超市碰到了老同学。
I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.
碰到问题就问老师。
Ask the teacher when you come up against a problem.
use: Spoken; like 遇到.

ex: 他们在山上观测星星。
They observe the stars from the mountain.
气象站每天观测天气。
The weather station observes the weather every day.
use: Science word: 天文观测, astronomical observation.

m: Things around the **home** and **meals**: a **guy**, or a tool.
ex: 你这个家伙，又迟到了！
You rascal, late again!
这家伙真聪明。
This guy is really smart.
use: Spoken, can be friendly or rude; also means a tool or weapon.

ex: 他是个很可靠的人。
He's a very reliable person.
这个消息可靠吗？
Is this news reliable?
use: For people, sources and machines.

ex: 人民不愿意再受压迫。
The people no longer wanted to be oppressed.
我胸口有种压迫的感觉。
I have a feeling of pressure on my chest.
use: Political oppression, or physical pressure.

m: In the **lining** of your **bosom**: in your **arms**.
ex: 妈妈把孩子抱在怀里。
The mother held the child in her arms.
小猫睡在我怀里。
The kitten is sleeping in my arms.
use: Usually 抱在怀里 or 在…怀里.

ex: 这本书描写了农村的生活。
This book depicts life in the countryside.
他把那个地方描写得很美。
He described the place beautifully.
use: For writing; 描述 is a plainer word for describing.

ex: 庙里有很多菩萨像。
There are many statues of bodhisattvas in the temple.
奶奶每天拜菩萨。
Grandma prays to the bodhisattvas every day.
use: Also used loosely for Buddhist figures; 菩萨心肠, a kind heart.

ex: 咸宁市有很多温泉。
Xianning City has many hot springs.
我们周末去咸宁市泡温泉。
We went to Xianning for the hot springs at the weekend.
use: 市 marks a city.

m: An official who **made** the **joints** and **measures** of a region obey: a **military governor**.
ex: 唐朝有很多节度使。
The Tang dynasty had many regional military governors.
安禄山当过节度使。
An Lushan served as a military governor.
use: Historical title from the Tang and Song.

m: The **study** of how to run the world and **cross the river** of life: **economics**.
ex: 他在大学学经济学。
He studies economics at university.
这本经济学的书很难懂。
This economics book is hard to understand.
use: 学 marks a field; 经济学家 is an economist.

ex: 学生们齐声说：老师好！
The students said in chorus: Good morning, teacher!
大家齐声唱起了生日歌。
Everyone sang Happy Birthday together.
use: Before a verb of speaking or singing.

ex: 满洲是中国东北的旧称。
Manchuria is an old name for northeast China.
这本书讲的是满洲的历史。
This book is about the history of Manchuria.
use: Historical name; today 东北.

ex: 这是现存最古老的木塔。
This is the oldest surviving wooden pagoda.
现存的资料很少。
Very few records survive.
use: Before nouns: 现存的, still existing.

m: A **topic** given as an **order**: a **proposition**; set a topic.
ex: 这个命题是错的。
This proposition is false.
老师命题，我们写作文。
The teacher sets the topic and we write the essay.
use: Logic and maths, or setting exam questions.

ex: 雨伞是雨季的必备物品。
An umbrella is a must-have in the rainy season.
耐心是老师必备的品质。
Patience is an essential quality for a teacher.
use: Before nouns; 必备品, an essential item.

ex: 这家店有百年历史了。
This shop has a hundred years of history.
百年以后，谁还记得我们？
A hundred years from now, who will remember us?
use: 百年老店 is a long-established shop.

ex: 这条绳子的长度是多少？
How long is this rope?
文章的长度不能超过一千字。
The essay can't be more than a thousand characters long.
use: 长 is cháng here; 宽度 width, 高度 height.

ex: 压力在不断增大。
The pressure keeps growing.
请把字体增大一点。
Please make the font a bit bigger.
use: For size, pressure, chance; 增加 is for amounts.

ex: 这两条边的长度相等。
These two sides are equal in length.
他们的成绩相等。
Their scores are equal.
use: Maths and measurement; 平等 is equal in rights.

m: A **big** **gall bladder**, an old sign of courage: **bold**.
ex: 你大胆说吧，没关系。
Go on, speak up, it's fine.
这个想法很大胆。
This idea is very bold.
use: Positive bold or brazen depending on context.

ex: 华山非常险。
Mount Hua is very dangerous.
我们夜里爬上了华山。
We climbed Mount Hua during the night.
use: One of China's Five Great Mountains.

ex: 西晋的首都在洛阳。
The capital of the Western Jin was Luoyang.
西晋只有五十多年。
The Western Jin lasted only some fifty years.
use: Followed by 东晋, Eastern Jin.

ex: 我没有勇气跟她说话。
I don't have the courage to talk to her.
这需要很大的勇气。
This takes a lot of courage.
use: Goes with 有, 鼓起 (pluck up).

ex: 汉江在武汉流进长江。
The Han River flows into the Yangtze at Wuhan.
我们坐船游了汉江。
We took a boat trip on the Han River.
use: Also the Hangang in Seoul.

m: An old name: the **Xiongnu**, a steppe people of ancient times.
ex: 匈奴常常进攻汉朝。
The Xiongnu often attacked the Han dynasty.
长城最早是为了防匈奴而修的。
The Great Wall was first built to keep out the Xiongnu.
use: Historical people; names here are used for sound.

ex: 这是一所综合性大学。
This is a comprehensive university.
这个问题的综合性很强。
This problem draws on many areas.
use: Mostly before nouns: 综合性大学, 综合性医院.

ex: 他的想法太极端了。
His ideas are too extreme.
今年夏天有很多极端天气。
There has been a lot of extreme weather this summer.
use: Often critical: 极端的看法.

m: **Use** it to **do** a job: **use as**, serve as.
ex: 这个房间用作办公室。
This room is used as an office.
这种草可以用作药。
This herb can be used as medicine.
use: Pattern: A 用作 B; like 当作.

ex: 今天是我们结婚十周年。
Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.
学校在庆祝建校一百周年。
The school is celebrating its centenary.
use: Number + 周年.

ex: 请带好您的随身物品。
Please take all your belongings with you.
这些物品不能带上飞机。
These items can't be taken on the plane.
use: Formal, used on notices; 东西 in speech.

ex: 越南菜很好吃。
Vietnamese food is delicious.
我去过越南两次。
I've been to Vietnam twice.
use: 越南人 is a Vietnamese person.

ex: 他心里很不安。
He feels very uneasy.
这件事让我感到不安。
This makes me feel uneasy.
use: For feelings or unstable situations; 不安全 is unsafe.

ex: 她很有个性。
She has a lot of personality.
每个孩子都有自己的个性。
Every child has their own personality.
use: 有个性 means distinctive, a bit unusual.

ex: 他每天写作三个小时。
He writes for three hours every day.
我的写作水平还不够高。
My writing still isn't good enough.
use: Writing as an activity; 写 takes direct objects.

ex: 他可谓是中国最好的作家之一。
He could be called one of China's best writers.
这次旅行可谓收获很大。
This trip was, you might say, very rewarding.
use: Written style; like 可以说.

m: **Articles** made by a **system**: **products** made of something.
ex: 这家店卖奶制品。
This shop sells dairy products.
塑料制品对环境不好。
Plastic products are bad for the environment.
use: Material + 制品: 木制品, 皮制品.

m: An **injured** **mouth** in the skin: a **wound**, cut.
ex: 伤口还在流血。
The wound is still bleeding.
你的伤口要每天换药。
Your wound needs a fresh dressing every day.
use: Measure word 个 or 道.

ex: 他大学毕业以后就去创业了。
He started his own business after graduating.
创业很难，但是很有意思。
Starting a business is hard but very interesting.
use: 创业者 is an entrepreneur.

m: **Sweet** and **respectful**: **Gansu**, a province in northwest China.
ex: 甘肃在中国的西北部。
Gansu is in northwest China.
我想去甘肃看敦煌。
I want to go to Gansu to see Dunhuang.
use: Province name; short form 甘.

ex: 他悄悄地走进了房间。
He quietly walked into the room.
她悄悄告诉我一个秘密。
She quietly told me a secret.
use: Often 悄悄地 before a verb; 悄悄话 is a whisper.

m: A **time** named after an **earthly branch**: an old two-hour **period**; the time.
ex: 古时候一天有十二个时辰。
In ancient times a day had twelve two-hour periods.
时辰不早了，快睡吧。
It's getting late, go to sleep.
use: Old-fashioned; one 时辰 is two hours.

ex: 这几个国家的经济已经连成一体。
These countries' economies have become one whole.
这台机器集打印和复印于一体。
This machine combines printing and copying in one.
use: Patterns 融为一体 (merge into one), 集…于一体.

ex: 我们的祖先在这里住了几百年。
Our ancestors lived here for hundreds of years.
过年的时候很多人会祭拜祖先。
At New Year many people make offerings to their ancestors.
use: Also 祖宗 in speech.

ex: 我还没做完作业。
I haven't finished my homework yet.
老师今天留了很多作业。
The teacher set a lot of homework today.
use: Goes with 做 and 交 (hand in).

ex: 他文武双全。
He is skilled with both pen and sword.
朝廷里有文武百官。
The court had all its civil and military officials.
use: Fixed phrases: 文武双全, 文武百官.

m: The **wind** of how you **do** things: **style of work**, conduct.
ex: 他的工作作风很严谨。
He has a very rigorous working style.
我们要改进干部的作风。
We need to improve the conduct of officials.
use: Often about work habits and moral conduct.

ex: 这种车很适合大众。
This kind of car suits ordinary people.
我爸爸开的是一辆大众。
My dad drives a Volkswagen.
use: 大众 + noun: 大众文化, popular culture.

m: **According to** what is **known**: **it is reported that**.
ex: 据悉，这家公司明年会上市。
It is reported that this company will go public next year.
据悉，事故中没有人受伤。
According to reports, no one was hurt in the accident.
use: News style; starts a sentence followed by a comma.

m: The **big** **palace hall**: the **main hall** of a temple.
ex: 大殿里有一座很大的佛像。
There's a huge Buddha statue in the main hall.
我们在寺庙的大殿前拍了照。
We took photos in front of the temple's main hall.
use: Measure word 座.

ex: 这个地方的手工业很发达。
Handicraft industry is well developed here.
古代的手工业主要在城市。
Ancient crafts were mostly based in towns.
use: History and economics word; 手工 alone is handwork.

ex: 每当下雨，我就想起家乡。
Whenever it rains, I think of my home town.
每当我难过的时候，她都来陪我。
Whenever I'm sad, she comes to keep me company.
use: Often 每当…的时候 / …就….

ex: 这片海域鱼很多。
There are lots of fish in these waters.
船在这片海域失去了联系。
The ship lost contact in this sea area.
use: Formal; for maps and news.

m: **Send out** your **words**: **speak** at a meeting, a speech.
ex: 会上他第一个发言。
He was the first to speak at the meeting.
她的发言很有道理。
Her remarks made a lot of sense.
use: For meetings and classes; 发言人 is a spokesperson.

m: **Protect** against it and **treat** it: **prevent and cure**.
ex: 我们要做好疾病的防治工作。
We must do a good job of preventing and treating disease.
这种药可以防治感冒。
This medicine can prevent and treat colds.
use: For diseases, pests, pollution.

ex: 这幅画颜色很鲜明。
This painting's colours are very bright.
两个人的性格对比鲜明。
The two people have sharply contrasting personalities.
use: Also for clear positions: 态度鲜明.

ex: 朝鲜半岛在中国的东边。
The Korean Peninsula is to the east of China.
这个半岛三面都是海。
This peninsula has sea on three sides.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 他在班上很孤立。
He's quite isolated in class.
大家不应该孤立新同学。
Everyone shouldn't leave the new classmate out.
use: Also an isolated event: 孤立的事件.

ex: 我给那家公司发了简历。
I sent my CV to that company.
你的简历写得很清楚。
Your résumé is very clearly written.
use: Goes with 投 or 发 (send).

ex: 他在木头上雕刻了一只鸟。
He carved a bird into the wood.
这里的石头雕刻很有名。
The stone carvings here are famous.
use: For wood, stone, jade.

ex: 这块石英很漂亮。
This piece of quartz is very pretty.
石英手表很准。
Quartz watches keep good time.
use: Mostly in 石英表, a quartz watch.

m: If you **want** to **speak** of it: **when it comes to**.
ex: 要说做饭，还是我妈做得最好。
When it comes to cooking, my mum is the best.
要说他不努力，那不对。
To say he doesn't work hard would be wrong.
use: Spoken; starts the sentence to introduce a topic.

m: **Set up** a picture and **think** about it: **imagine**, a plan.
ex: 我设想过很多种结果。
I imagined many possible outcomes.
这只是一个初步的设想。
This is just a preliminary idea.
use: Also in 不堪设想, too terrible to imagine.

ex: 这艘船穿过了大西洋。
This ship crossed the Atlantic.
大西洋在欧洲和美洲之间。
The Atlantic lies between Europe and the Americas.
use: 太平洋 is the Pacific.

ex: 法国是欧盟成员国。
France is a member state of the EU.
欧盟出台了新的规定。
The EU has issued new rules.
use: 欧 here is short for 欧洲, Europe.

m: **Pay** and let it **go out**: **pay**, put in effort.
ex: 他为家庭付出了很多。
He has given a lot for his family.
有付出就会有收获。
If you put in the effort, you'll get results.
use: Mostly about effort, time, a price paid.

m: The **area** inside the **city walls**: the **urban area**, city district.
ex: 我住在城区，上班很方便。
I live in the city area, so commuting is easy.
新城区比老城区干净。
The new part of town is cleaner than the old part.
use: Opposite 郊区, suburbs; also a district name.

ex: 我从未见过这么美的地方。
I've never seen such a beautiful place.
他从未迟到过。
He has never been late.
use: Written for 从来没有; often with 过.

ex: 总之，我们明天必须完成。
In short, we have to finish tomorrow.
他说了很多理由，总之就是不想去。
He gave many reasons; in a word, he didn't want to go.
use: Starts a summing-up sentence.

ex: 武汉是湖北的省会。
Wuhan is the capital of Hubei.
省会城市一般比较大。
Provincial capitals are usually quite big.
use: 省 here means province; 会 means gathering place.

ex: 这个盒子很精美。
This box is exquisite.
她送了我一份精美的礼物。
She gave me a beautiful gift.
use: For crafted things, gifts, pictures.

ex: 这道题难度很大。
This question is very difficult.
这个动作的难度很高。
This move has a high degree of difficulty.
use: Goes with 大, 高, 增加.

ex: 这家工厂生产汽车零部件。
This factory makes car parts.
这台机器的零部件很难买到。
Parts for this machine are hard to get.
use: Collective; 零件 is a single part.

ex: 今天高温三十八度。
Today's high is thirty-eight degrees.
高温天气要多喝水。
Drink plenty of water in hot weather.
use: Weather reports: 高温预警, heat warning.

m: **Well up** and **appear**: **spring up** in large numbers.
ex: 最近涌现了很多新公司。
Lots of new companies have sprung up recently.
这个学校涌现出很多优秀学生。
This school has produced many outstanding students.
use: For people, ideas, businesses appearing in numbers.

ex: 台风今天晚上登陆。
The typhoon will make landfall tonight.
这个产品明年登陆中国市场。
This product will enter the Chinese market next year.
use: Typhoons, troops, products entering a market; not 登录 (log in).

ex: 他在气象台工作。
He works at the weather station.
城市出现了新气象。
The city has taken on a new look.
use: 气象 is weather science; 天气 is everyday weather.

ex: 交通很缓慢。
The traffic is very slow.
他缓慢地走上楼。
He slowly walked upstairs.
use: Written; 慢 in speech.

ex: 他违反了交通规则。
He broke the traffic rules.
这样做违反法律。
Doing this breaks the law.
use: Object: 规定, 法律, 纪律; 违法 is to break the law.

ex: 她是天主教徒。
She's a Catholic.
这座城市有一座天主教教堂。
This city has a Catholic church.
use: 基督教 often means Protestantism.

ex: 在我眼中，你是最好的。
In my eyes, you're the best.
在孩子眼中，世界很简单。
To a child, the world is simple.
use: Pattern: 在…眼中, in someone's view.

ex: 本月十五号开会。
There is a meeting on the fifteenth of this month.
本月的电费比上个月高。
This month's electricity bill is higher than last month's.
use: Formal; 这个月 in speech.

ex: 你喜欢吃什么水果？
What fruit do you like?
我每天都吃水果。
I eat fruit every day.
use: Measure word 种; 果 alone is rare in speech.

ex: 今晚我们去看电影吧。
Let's go see a film tonight.
今晚会下雨吗？
Will it rain tonight?
use: Short for 今天晚上.

ex: 她们是姊妹。
They are sisters.
这两所学校是姊妹学校。
These two schools are sister schools.
use: More literary than 姐妹; 姊妹城市, twin cities.

ex: 世界上没有完美的人。
Nobody in the world is perfect.
这次演出非常完美。
This performance was perfect.
use: Also 完美主义, perfectionism.

ex: 请坐这把椅子。
Please sit in this chair.
教室里有三十把椅子。
There are thirty chairs in the classroom.
use: Measure word 把.

ex: 老师纠正了我的发音。
The teacher corrected my pronunciation.
有错误要马上纠正。
Mistakes should be corrected right away.
use: For mistakes and bad habits; 改正 is correct your own.

ex: 我们打败了对手。
We beat our opponents.
他从来没被困难打败过。
He has never been beaten by hardship.
use: Spoken; 击败 is more formal.

m: **Lu** the **rapid** writer: the pen name of **Lu Xun**, China's great modern author.
ex: 鲁迅是中国有名的作家。
Lu Xun is a famous Chinese writer.
我们在课上学过鲁迅的文章。
We studied Lu Xun's essays in class.
use: A pen name; his real name was 周树人.

ex: 这座旧楼下个月拆除。
This old building will be demolished next month.
工人们拆除了旧桥。
The workers tore down the old bridge.
use: Formal; 拆 alone in speech, and on walls you see 拆.

ex: 我不想得罪他。
I don't want to offend him.
说话太直容易得罪人。
Being too blunt easily offends people.
use: Takes a person as object.

m: **Water** put to **sharp**, good use: **water conservancy**, irrigation.
ex: 这个地区的水利工程很重要。
The water projects in this area are very important.
他是水利专家。
He is an expert in water conservancy.
use: 利 here means benefit.

ex: 这种药能减轻疼痛。
This medicine can ease the pain.
我们要减轻学生的负担。
We need to lighten students' workload.
use: For pain, burden, pressure; 减少 is reduce in number.

ex: 这个节日的起源很早。
This festival has very old origins.
足球起源于英国吗？
Did football originate in England?
use: Verb pattern 起源于, originate in.

ex: 原子里有很多更小的粒子。
Atoms contain many even smaller particles.
空气中有很多细小的粒子。
The air contains lots of tiny particles.
use: Physics word.

ex: 他在车祸中受了重伤。
He was seriously injured in the car crash.
两人重伤，三人轻伤。
Two people were seriously injured and three slightly hurt.
use: Goes with 受; opposite 轻伤.

ex: 他在一家冶金公司工作。
He works at a metallurgy company.
这个城市的冶金工业很发达。
This city's metal industry is well developed.
use: Technical word.

ex: 这几根柱子支撑着屋顶。
These pillars hold up the roof.
是信念支撑他走下去。
It was his belief that kept him going.
use: Literal and figurative support.

ex: 这辆车的造型很好看。
This car has a great design.
她今天换了一个新造型。
She has a new look today.
use: For design and styling, including hair and outfits.

ex: 桂林山水很有名。
Guilin's scenery is famous.
他喜欢画山水画。
He likes painting landscapes.
use: 山水画 is Chinese landscape painting.

m: **Bring up** a question and **ask**: **ask a question**.
ex: 有问题可以提问。
You can ask if you have questions.
老师上课时经常提问。
The teacher often asks questions in class.
use: No object: 向老师提问, ask the teacher a question.

m: A **cave** on the body's **road** of energy: an **acupuncture point**.
ex: 按这个穴道可以缓解头疼。
Pressing this point can ease headaches.
中医很重视穴道。
Chinese medicine pays great attention to acupoints.
use: Also 穴位.

m: The **city walls** of the **county**: a **county town**.
ex: 他在县城上中学。
He went to secondary school in the county town.
县城离我们村有二十公里。
The county town is twenty kilometres from our village.
use: The main town of a county.

ex: 我们的友谊很深。
Our friendship runs deep.
友谊第一，比赛第二。
Friendship first, competition second.
use: More formal than 友情.

ex: 我这个月的流量用完了。
I've used up my mobile data this month.
节假日的车流量很大。
Traffic is very heavy during holidays.
use: Very common for phone data.

ex: 清朝的皇帝是满族人。
The Qing emperors were Manchu.
满族的传统服装很漂亮。
Traditional Manchu clothing is beautiful.
use: 满 here stands for Manchu.

m: **Not** reaching: **fall short of**, not as good as.
ex: 我的中文远远不及他。
My Chinese is nowhere near as good as his.
后悔也来不及了。
It's too late to regret it now.
use: Also in 来不及, too late.

ex: 他是中国驻美国大使。
He is China's ambassador to the US.
大使参观了我们学校。
The ambassador visited our school.
use: 大使馆 is an embassy.

ex: 你长大以后想做什么？
What do you want to be when you grow up?
我是在北京长大的。
I grew up in Beijing.
use: 长 is zhǎng here.

m: **Using** this to **arrive** at: **up to**, so much that.
ex: 他工作太忙，以至忘了吃饭。
He was so busy he forgot to eat.
从城市以至农村，人人都在用手机。
From the cities down to the villages, everyone uses a mobile phone.
use: Compare 以致, which usually leads to a bad result.

ex: 这里的地貌很特别。
The landforms here are unusual.
这个地区有多种地貌。
This region has a variety of landforms.
use: Geography word.

m: A **hinge** and a **knob** that turn everything: a **hub**.
ex: 武汉是交通枢纽。
Wuhan is a transport hub.
这个车站是城市的交通枢纽。
This station is the city's transport hub.
use: Mostly 交通枢纽.

m: The whole **body**, **muddy** from head to foot: **all over**.
ex: 我浑身都湿了。
I'm soaked all over.
跑完步，他浑身是汗。
After running he was covered in sweat.
use: Pattern 浑身是…, covered in.

ex: 孩子们精力很旺盛。
The children are full of energy.
我没有精力做这么多事。
I don't have the energy to do so many things.
use: Mental and physical energy; 能量 is energy in physics.

ex: 这包茶叶是朋友送的。
This packet of tea was a gift from a friend.
杭州的茶叶很有名。
Hangzhou tea is famous.
use: The dry leaves; the drink is 茶.

ex: 他依旧每天早上跑步。
He still runs every morning.
这里的风景依旧很美。
The scenery here is as beautiful as ever.
use: Written; like 仍然.

ex: 他被任命为国务委员。
He was appointed State Councilor.
国务委员出席了会议。
The State Councilor attended the meeting.
use: Senior Chinese government title.

ex: 她是一位知名作家。
She is a well-known writer.
这是一家知名企业。
This is a well-known company.
use: Before nouns; 知名度 is fame, profile.

m: One chance in **ten thousand**: **just in case**, what if.
ex: 带把伞吧，万一下雨呢。
Take an umbrella, just in case it rains.
万一他不来怎么办？
What if he doesn't come?
use: For unlikely, usually unwelcome events.

m: The **army** that **divides** chains and **frees** the **people**: the **People's Liberation Army**.
ex: 他在人民解放军当过兵。
He served in the People's Liberation Army.
人民解放军帮助灾区救灾。
The PLA helped with disaster relief.
use: China's armed forces; short 解放军.

ex: 这里夏季很热。
It's very hot here in summer.
夏季的白天比较长。
Days are longer in summer.
use: More formal than 夏天.

ex: 我们去泰国度假了。
We went on holiday to Thailand.
泰国菜有点辣。
Thai food is a bit spicy.
use: 泰语 is Thai.

ex: 他十岁就登基了。
He became emperor at the age of ten.
新皇帝登基后改了年号。
After coming to the throne, the new emperor changed the reign name.
use: Historical.

m: **Receive** it and let it **enter**: **bring into**, include.
ex: 这个问题已经纳入计划了。
This issue has been included in the plan.
这种药被纳入了医保。
This drug has been included in medical insurance.
use: Formal; 纳入 + plan, system, scope.

m: An **official** who **served**: a **vice-minister** in imperial times.
ex: 他做过礼部侍郎。
He served as vice-minister of the Board of Rites.
侍郎是很高的官。
A vice-minister was a high-ranking official.
use: Historical title.

ex: 我接到了他的电话。
I got a call from him.
你接到通知了吗？
Have you received the notice?
use: Also pick someone up: 接到你了.

ex: 本市明天有雨。
There will be rain in the city tomorrow.
这项政策只在本市实行。
This policy only applies in this city.
use: Formal, in notices and news.

ex: 这是终身的事。
This is a lifelong matter.
他获得了终身成就奖。
He received a lifetime achievement award.
use: 终身学习, lifelong learning.

ex: 他一向很准时。
He has always been punctual.
我一向不喜欢吃辣的。
I've never liked spicy food.
use: Describes a long-standing habit; similar to 向来.

ex: 夏天的夜晚很凉快。
Summer nights are cool.
在那个安静的夜晚，我们聊了很久。
On that quiet night we talked for a long time.
use: More literary than 晚上.

ex: 不能带液体上飞机。
You can't take liquids on the plane.
水是一种液体。
Water is a liquid.
use: 固体 solid, 气体 gas.

m: **Shen** River's sunny side: **Shenyang**, capital of Liaoning.
ex: 沈阳冬天很冷。
Shenyang is very cold in winter.
我在沈阳上了大学。
I went to university in Shenyang.
use: Capital of Liaoning province.

ex: 这是中国特有的动物。
This is an animal found only in China.
她说话有一种特有的口音。
She speaks with a distinctive accent.
use: Pattern …特有的….

ex: 他勉强笑了笑。
He forced a smile.
你不想去就别勉强。
If you don't want to go, don't force yourself.
use: Also barely enough: 勉强够.

ex: 工厂需要更多生产资料。
The factory needs more means of production.
土地是重要的生产资料。
Land is an important means of production.
use: Economics and politics term.

ex: 你有证据吗？
Do you have evidence?
警察找到了新的证据。
The police found new evidence.
use: Measure word 个 or 条.

ex: 这项服务要额外收费。
There's an extra charge for this service.
老师给了我们额外的时间。
The teacher gave us extra time.
use: 额 here means a fixed quota.

ex: 猫在屋顶上睡觉。
The cat is sleeping on the roof.
屋顶漏水了。
The roof is leaking.
use: Often 屋顶上.
